title: Disconection alarm
body:
When the mobile is on silent mode the disconection alarm is only shown as a message on the screen but it does not sound.
Low and high glucose alerts sound when the mobile is on silent mode. They have override silent mode.But disconection alarm has not that option. Or i don't know how to do it. Sorry in that case.
Thanks in advance!
